title: TunnelOffer
description: Internet fallback offer carried in SessionRequest.tunnelOffer (Increment 5; null/absent in Increment 1). It travels only inside the mutually authenticated channel so the tunnel provider never learns `keyB64`. Mirrors TunnelOffer in packages/libreshare_core/lib/src/model/session_models.dart. Unknown members MUST be ignored.

provider.description: Tunnel provider tag, e.g. cloudflare-quick or zrok.

url.description: Public tunnel base URL including the /t/<token> path (token: 128-bit random, base64url).
